description: This file defines a controller class for managing user subscriptions within the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for listing subscriptions, displaying detailed subscription info, cancelling subscriptions, viewing order and history related to subscriptions, and handling pagination and address formatting.

classes.name: Subscription
classes.description: Controller class handling subscription-related actions for user account management in OpenCart.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays a list of subscriptions with pagination, including subscription status, description, and links to detailed view.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Shows detailed information for a specific subscription, including addresses, products, status, history, and related orders.

methods.name: cancel
methods.description: Handles requests to cancel a subscription, updating its status and returning JSON response.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Displays the history of a subscription's status changes or comments.

methods.name: getHistory
methods.description: Private method retrieving and paginating subscription history records.

methods.name: order
methods.description: Displays associated orders for a specific subscription.

methods.name: getOrders
methods.description: Private method retrieving and paginating subscription-related orders.
